title.zh: 【Ripple 与 Robinhood 达成战略合作】
title.en: 【Ripple 与 Robinhood 达成战略合作】

current_state.zh: Ripple and Robinhood announced a strategic partnership under which RLUSD will be integrated across Robinhood Chain, Bitstamp by Robinhood and later the Robinhood App for institutional settlement, while Robinhood adopts Ripple Treasury for global treasury automation and expands lending, margin financing and spot trading through Ripple Prime.
